contract.traceability: Reference `ref` (TestRail case id, e.g. C4099911) in each automated test so a result maps back to its case.
contract.markers: Mirror device + feature as pytest markers; add @pytest.mark.destructive where destructive is true (deselected by default).
contract.cross_check: cross_check lists the back-office systems the case asserts — the test must verify the event landed there (CloudFare / MERIT / SmartTrack).
contract.note: automatable/priority are system-test-ops judgements and a starting point; the automation engineer may override with rationale.

cases.title: ABT — successful tap, passback and mobile wallet

gherkin.given: **Given** ABT taps are enabled and the ETM is at the FLU screen

steps.when: **WHEN** a customer taps a valid contactless card or device
steps.then:
**THEN** the tap is accepted for the journey
**AND** a success tone is played
**AND** the passenger display shows "Success"

steps.when: **WHEN** the same card is tapped again
steps.then: **THEN** the ETM enters passback mode for the additional passenger

steps.when: **WHEN** the customer taps a mobile wallet
steps.then: **THEN** the wallet tap is accepted as for a contactless card

gherkin.expected: A valid ABT tap is accepted (success tone, "Success"); a second tap enters passback; mobile wallets are accepted — Visa, Mastercard, Apple/Google/Samsung Pay, phone and watch.

cases.title: ABT — declined, error and EMV validation failures

gherkin.given: **Given** ABT taps are enabled and the ETM is at the FLU screen

steps.when: **WHEN** a customer taps a card that is declined, expired, deny/BIN-listed, or that mis-reads
steps.then:
**THEN** the error tone is played
**AND** a declined receipt is printed
**AND** the passenger display shows "See Driver"

steps.when: **WHEN** an EMV validation fails
steps.then: **THEN** the matching EMV validation-failure screen is shown for the reason

gherkin.expected: Declined/errored taps give the error tone, declined receipt and "See Driver"; the correct EMV validation-failure screen shows for tap-error, expired, declined and already-validated.

gherkin.given: **Given** ABT is configured as enabled

steps.when: **WHEN** the ETM is at the FLU screen ready for taps
steps.then: **THEN** ABT taps are accepted

steps.when: **WHEN** the ETM is on a basket screen, in basket mode, Driver Break, a smartcard screen, the annul screen, the Start New Journey flow, or Travel Mode above 5kph
steps.then: **THEN** ABT taps are not enabled

steps.when: **WHEN** the CloudFare activity log is checked
steps.then: **THEN** the corresponding event is recorded in the Back Office System (CloudFare) activity log

gherkin.expected: ABT taps are accepted only at FLU-ready states and ignored on basket/break/smartcard/annul/start-new-journey/travel-mode-above-5kph.

gherkin.given: **Given** ABT is enabled in a Metro ABT zone

steps.when: **WHEN** the customer taps for boarding only, alighting only, or both within the Metro ABT zone

steps.when: **WHEN** the data is reviewed in MERIT
steps.then: **THEN** the transaction appears in MERIT

steps.then: **THEN** the ABT journey is recorded for the corresponding boarding/alighting points

steps.when: **WHEN** the data is reviewed in MERIT

cases.title: ABT — reverts to standard fixed fare on rule change

gherkin.given: **Given** a Driver is signed on and barcode scanning is available

steps.when: **WHEN** a valid barcode ticket is scanned and validated online
steps.then:
**THEN** the ticket is accepted with the correct validity detail shown
**AND** the validation is recorded in the back office (CloudFare and MERIT)

steps.when: **WHEN** a barcode fails online validation
steps.then: **THEN** the transaction is cancelled with the failure reason shown

gherkin.expected: Valid barcodes validate online with the validity detail; failures cancel with the reason — decryption failed, not valid, already used, wrong date, expired, exceeds offline limit, invalid product, visual inspection not passed. Printed copy and mobile phone.

gherkin.given: **Given** the ETM is validating a barcode offline

steps.when: **WHEN** a valid barcode is scanned within the offline validation limit
steps.then:
**THEN** the ticket is accepted offline
**AND** the offline validation is recorded for upload to the back office (CloudFare and MERIT)

steps.when: **WHEN** the barcode is over the offline validation limit or invalid
steps.then: **THEN** the barcode is rejected with the reason shown

gherkin.expected: Offline validation accepts within the limit and rejects when over the offline limit or invalid.

gherkin.given: **Given** a Driver is signed on and barcode scanning is available

steps.when: **WHEN** a multiple-use barcode is scanned and multiple use is confirmed
steps.then:
**THEN** the multiple-use ticket is validated
**AND** the validation is recorded in the back office (CloudFare and MERIT)

steps.when: **WHEN** validation fails
steps.then: **THEN** the failure reason is shown (passback, incorrect zone, wrong start/end date, or wrong travel method)

gherkin.expected: Multiple-use barcodes validate with confirmation; failures show passback / incorrect zone / wrong dates / wrong travel method. Covers printed copy and mobile phone.

gherkin.given: **Given** a Driver is signed on and barcode scanning is available

steps.when: **WHEN** a valid mLink barcode is scanned
steps.then:
**THEN** the mLink barcode is validated
**AND** the validation is recorded in the back office (CloudFare and MERIT)

steps.when: **WHEN** an expired mLink barcode is scanned
steps.then: **THEN** the mLink barcode is rejected as expired

gherkin.expected: mLink barcodes validate when valid and reject when expired.

cases.title: Barcode — reference entry via Driver Menu

gherkin.given: **Given** a Driver has opened the barcode reference entry from the Driver Menu

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver enters a valid single-use or multiple-use barcode reference
steps.then:

cases.title: Basket Mode — build a multi-item basket and pay

gherkin.given: **Given** a Driver is signed on at the FLU screen

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver presses R6 to enter basket mode with a product/alighting stage selected
steps.then: **THEN** the selected product is added to the basket and basket mode is active

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver adds further items, confirms the basket and takes payment
steps.then:
**THEN** all basket items are issued in one transaction
**AND** the sale is recorded in the back office (CloudFare and MERIT)
**AND** a receipt is printed automatically where mandatory

gherkin.expected: Basket mode issues multiple items in one paid transaction; the selected product is auto-added on entry; a mandatory receipt prints automatically.

cases.title: Basket Mode — limits and line-item quantity

gherkin.given: **Given** a Driver has nine items in the basket

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver attempts to add another from the FLU or basket screen
steps.then: **THEN** the Basket Full error is shown and no item is added

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver removes an item
steps.then: **THEN** a new item can be added

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver adjusts a line-item quantity with the '+' or '-' keys
steps.then: **THEN** the quantity changes, or a relevant error is shown for two seconds when it cannot

gherkin.expected: The basket caps at nine with a Basket Full error; removing frees a slot; line-item quantity adjusts with +/- (2s error when it cannot change).

cases.title: Basket Mode — clear, add more and basket tracker

gherkin.given: **Given** a Driver has items in the basket

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver selects Add More to Basket
steps.then: **THEN** the ETM returns to FLU with the basket retained

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver navigates into a Promo Menu sub-menu
steps.then: **THEN** the basket tracker remains displayed and functional

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver selects Clear Basket
steps.then:
**THEN** the ETM returns to FLU
**AND** the basket is emptied and the product reverts to default

gherkin.expected: Add More keeps the basket; the basket tracker persists across screens incl. Promo sub-menus; Clear Basket empties it and reverts to default.

cases.title: Basket Mode — annul a basketed transaction

gherkin.given: **Given** a Driver has issued a basket of tickets

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver annuls the basketed transaction
steps.then:

steps.when: **WHEN** the CloudFare activity log is checked
steps.then: **THEN** the corresponding event is recorded in the Back Office System (CloudFare) activity log

steps.when: **WHEN** the data is reviewed in MERIT
steps.then: **THEN** the transaction appears in MERIT

gherkin.expected: A basketed transaction can be annulled and recorded.

gherkin.given: **Given** a customer is tapping journeys within a capping group

steps.when: **WHEN** the qualifying journeys for the cap are reached
steps.then: **THEN** the cap is applied and no further fare is charged for the capped period

steps.when: **WHEN** the CloudFare activity log is checked

steps.when: **WHEN** the data is reviewed in MERIT
steps.then: **THEN** the transaction appears in MERIT

gherkin.expected: The cap applies once reached. Run for same-day and weekly caps. (Ulsterbus mode.)

gherkin.given: **Given** a customer is tapping journeys within a capping group

steps.when: **WHEN** the journeys taken are below the cap threshold
steps.then: **THEN** each journey is charged normally

steps.when: **WHEN** the CloudFare activity log is checked
steps.then: **THEN** the corresponding event is recorded in the Back Office System (CloudFare) activity log

steps.when: **WHEN** the data is reviewed in MERIT
steps.then: **THEN** the transaction appears in MERIT

gherkin.expected: Journeys below the cap are charged normally. Run for same-day and weekly. (Ulsterbus mode.)

gherkin.given: **Given** a daily capping group spans multiple services and transport modes

steps.when: **WHEN** the customer taps journeys across those services and modes
steps.then: **THEN** the journeys aggregate toward the same cap

steps.when: **WHEN** the CloudFare activity log is checked
steps.then: **THEN** the corresponding event is recorded in the Back Office System (CloudFare) activity log

steps.when: **WHEN** the data is reviewed in MERIT
steps.then: **THEN** the transaction appears in MERIT

gherkin.expected: Capping aggregates across multiple services and transport modes within a daily capping group. (Ulsterbus mode.)

cases.title: Driver Break — enter, leave and override

gherkin.given: **Given** a Driver is signed on

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver selects Driver Break to enter break mode
steps.then:
**THEN** the ETM shows the On Break idle screen
**AND** only the operator who started the break may sign back in

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver leaves the break by manual sign-in or Staff card, or aborts the leave
steps.then: **THEN** the Driver resumes the shift, or the abort returns to the On Break screen

steps.when: **WHEN** a Supervisor signs in during the break
steps.then: **THEN** the Supervisor overrides the break

steps.when: **WHEN** the TMS-configured break time elapses
steps.then: **THEN** the Driver is signed out and others may sign in

steps.when: **WHEN** the CloudFare activity log is checked
steps.then: **THEN** the corresponding event is recorded in the Back Office System (CloudFare) activity log

gherkin.expected: Driver Break locks sign-in to that operator; leave (manual/smartcard) or abort works; Supervisor can override; the break auto-ends after the configured time and signs the Driver out.

gherkin.given: **Given** a Driver has opened the Driver Menu

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver changes the currency to Euros

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver changes the currency back to Pounds
steps.then: **THEN** the sale currency is set to Pounds

gherkin.given: **Given** the Inspector option is selected from the Driver Menu

steps.then: **THEN** the Inspector report is produced

cases.title: Driver options — ticket history and last ticket

gherkin.given: **Given** a Driver has opened Driver options

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver views the ticket history
steps.then:
**THEN** the issued tickets are listed and can be scrolled with the up/down arrows
**AND** annulled transactions are marked with a cross

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver selects the last ticket issued
steps.then: **THEN** the ticket detail is displayed

gherkin.expected: Ticket history lists tickets (annulled marked); the last ticket issued can be viewed.

gherkin.given: **Given** a Driver is signed on at the FLU Home screen

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver views a product group with more than one product
steps.then:
**THEN** up to four toggle pips are shown for the first four products
**AND** a '+' icon is shown when the group holds more than four, highlighted when an extended product is chosen

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver selects a preset or menu-type product

cases.title: FLU — set boarding and alighting stages

gherkin.given: **Given** a Driver is signed on at the FLU screen for a known route

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver changes the boarding stage while outside the GPS footprint and below 20kph
steps.then: **THEN** the boarding stage is updated

steps.when: **WHEN** the bus is inside the GPS footprint or above 20kph
steps.then: **THEN** manual boarding-stage change is unavailable

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver views and pages the alighting stages
steps.then: **THEN** up to five are shown with the fifth always the route's last stage, paging with no timeout

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver selects an alighting stage
steps.then: **THEN** the selected stage is applied to the sale

gherkin.expected: Boarding stage changes only when outside GPS footprint and below 20kph (or by stage ID); alighting stages page five-at-a-time with the last stage always reachable.

cases.title: FLU — numeric entry, change and last transaction

gherkin.given: **Given** a Driver is signed on at the FLU screen

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver enters an amount tendered
steps.then:
**THEN** the change due is calculated
**AND** the change due is displayed

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver enters a stage ID to set the boarding or alighting stage
steps.then: **THEN** the matching stage is set

steps.when: **WHEN** an entry cannot be completed
steps.then:
**THEN** the relevant error-bar message is shown
**AND** the input is cleared, and 'C' clears one character

steps.when: **WHEN** a sale completes
steps.then: **THEN** a success confirmation shows for three seconds with the last transaction in the bottom-right of FLU

gherkin.expected: Numeric entry calculates change and sets stages by ID; invalid entries show the error-bar message and clear ('C' clears a char); completed sales show a 3s success plus the last transaction.

gherkin.given: **Given** a Driver is signed on at the FLU screen

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver builds a group ticket and takes payment
steps.then:
**THEN** the group ticket is issued at the correct price
**AND** a ticket is printed

gherkin.expected: A group ticket is priced, paid and issued with a printed ticket.

cases.title: FLU — ticket type selection, change and default reversion

gherkin.given: **Given** a Driver is signed on at the FLU screen

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver selects a ticket type
steps.then: **THEN** the fare for that ticket type is displayed

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver changes the ticket type
steps.then: **THEN** the fare display updates to the new ticket type

steps.when: **WHEN** a non-default ticket class is left idle for the configured timeout
steps.then: **THEN** the ticket class reverts to the default

gherkin.expected: Selecting/changing the ticket type updates the fare; a non-default class reverts to default after the inactivity timeout.

cases.title: FLU — currency switch to Euro and back

gherkin.given: **Given** a Driver is signed on with an alighting stage selectable

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver presses the alighting-stage key a second time
steps.then: **THEN** the currency switches to Euro (€)

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver presses the alighting-stage key a third time
steps.then: **THEN** the currency switches back to Pounds (£)

gherkin.expected: The alighting-stage key toggles the sale currency £ → € → £.

gherkin.given: **Given** a Driver is signed on at the FLU screen

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver records a passenger count
steps.then: **THEN** the passenger count is captured against the journey

gherkin.expected: A passenger count is captured against the journey.

gherkin.given: **Given** a Driver is signed on at the FLU screen

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver opens the favourite stages
steps.then: **THEN** the configured favourite stages are listed

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver selects a favourite stage
steps.then: **THEN** the selected stage is applied

gherkin.expected: Favourite stages are listed and a selection is applied.

cases.title: FLU — start a new journey mid-shift

gherkin.given: **Given** a Driver is signed on and partway through a shift

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver selects Start New Journey and confirms a new route and journey number
steps.then:
**THEN** the ETM updates to the new route and journey
**AND** the change is audited

gherkin.expected: Start New Journey re-selects route/journey mid-shift and audits the change.

gherkin.given: **Given** a Driver is signed on with GPS active on a route

steps.when: **WHEN** the ETM acquires a GPS lock or detects a new location
steps.then: **THEN** the matching notification is shown

steps.when: **WHEN** the bus arrives at or departs a stop
steps.then: **THEN** the arrival and departure are detected

steps.when: **WHEN** the bus approaches the next stop
steps.then: **THEN** the ETM looks ahead and updates the current stage

gherkin.expected: GPS lock/new-location notifications show; arrival and departure are detected; look-ahead updates the current stage.

gherkin.given: **Given** a Driver is signed on and taking cash fares

steps.when: **WHEN** the takings approach the pre-configured revenue limit
steps.then:
**THEN** a revenue-limit-approaching notification appears in the header after the Transaction Complete banner
**AND** the notification disappears after three seconds

steps.when: **WHEN** the CloudFare activity log is checked
steps.then: **THEN** the corresponding event is recorded in the Back Office System (CloudFare) activity log

gherkin.expected: A revenue-limit-approaching header notification shows after the Transaction Complete banner and clears after 3 seconds.

cases.title: Revenue Limit — reached locks the ETM

gherkin.given: **Given** a Driver is signed on and the takings reach the maximum revenue limit

steps.when: **WHEN** the revenue limit is reached
steps.then:
**THEN** the Driver is automatically signed off
**AND** a waybill is printed
**AND** the ETM locks
**AND** a Supervisor or Technician is required to resolve it
**AND** the ETM retrieves its back-office connection in the background

steps.when: **WHEN** the CloudFare activity log is checked
steps.then: **THEN** the corresponding event is recorded in the Back Office System (CloudFare) activity log

gherkin.expected: Reaching max revenue auto-signs-off the Driver, prints a waybill, locks the ETM (needs Supervisor/Technician) and re-establishes the back-office connection in the background.

cases.title: Driver Sign On — Manual, first use

gherkin.given:
**Given** the ETM is displaying the idle screen
**AND** the ETM is communicating with CloudFare

steps.when: **WHEN** the Enter key is pressed and a valid Staff ID (4–6 digits) and PIN are entered, confirming each with Enter
steps.then:
**THEN** the ETM authenticates the operator against the authorised user list
**AND** each PIN digit is masked with a '*' on entry
**AND** the First Use Safety Check screen is displayed

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver confirms the bus has been safety checked and answers the Any Defects prompt
steps.then: **THEN** the Duty Number entry screen is displayed

steps.when: **WHEN** an invalid duty number is entered, then a valid duty number is entered and confirmed
steps.then: **THEN** the invalid duty is rejected before the valid one advances to route selection

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver selects a route by letters or number, with inbound and outbound journeys filtered
steps.then: **THEN** the matching route is selected

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver selects the journey, an invalid journey number is rejected, and the Route Summary is confirmed
steps.then: **THEN** the Message of the Day screen is presented, or its Unavailable fallback after the 5-second timeout

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver confirms the Message of the Day
steps.then: **THEN** the Word and Colours of the Day screen is presented, or its Unavailable fallback after the 5-second timeout

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver confirms the Word and Colours of the Day
steps.then:
**THEN** the FLU screen is displayed
**AND** the start of shift is audited
**AND** the running total is recorded

steps.when: **WHEN** the shift is reviewed in CloudFare
steps.then: **THEN** the staff activity, shift details and defect record can be identified

gherkin.expected: The Driver reaches the FLU screen signed on, and the start of shift (with defect record) is auditable in CloudFare.

cases.title: Driver Sign On — Smartcard, first use

**Given** the ETM is displaying the idle screen
**AND** the ETM is communicating with CloudFare

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver presents a Staff pass carrying a Staff ID
steps.then:
**THEN** the operator sign-on screen is displayed with the Staff ID pre-populated

steps.then: **THEN** the ETM authenticates the operator and displays the First Use Safety Check screen

steps.when: **WHEN** the Staff pass is removed
steps.then: **THEN** the ETM remains on the First Use Safety Check screen and sign-on continues as normal

steps.when: **WHEN** the CloudFare activity log is checked
steps.then: **THEN** the corresponding event is recorded in the Back Office System (CloudFare) activity log

gherkin.expected: The Staff pass pre-populates the ID; after a valid PIN the Driver proceeds through the first-use flow.

cases.title: Driver Sign On — first use with defects recorded

**AND** sign-on continues to the Duty Number entry screen

steps.when: **WHEN** the shift is reviewed in CloudFare
steps.then: **THEN** the defect record can be identified against the Driver and vehicle

gherkin.given: **Given** the ETM is displaying the idle screen and a first-use safety check has already been performed for the vehicle today

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver signs on with a valid ID and PIN

**THEN** the ETM authenticates the operator

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver completes duty, route and journey selection

steps.when: **WHEN** the CloudFare activity log is checked
steps.then: **THEN** the corresponding event is recorded in the Back Office System (CloudFare) activity log

cases.title: Driver Sign On — incorrect PIN locks the device after the configured attempts

gherkin.given:
**Given** the ETM is in idle mode prompting for sign-on
**AND** a configurable failed-attempt threshold is set in the TMS

steps.when: **WHEN** an invalid PIN is entered for a valid Staff ID, by manual entry and by Staff pass

steps.when: **WHEN** the CloudFare activity log is checked
steps.then: **THEN** the corresponding event is recorded in the Back Office System (CloudFare) activity log

cases.title: Driver Sign On — communications locked / not communicating with CloudFare

gherkin.given: **Given** the ETM has not communicated with CloudFare for the configured number of hours

steps.when: **WHEN** the idle screen is shown
steps.then: **THEN** a bad-comms indicator is displayed and communications are locked

steps.when: **WHEN** the Driver attempts to sign on
steps.then:
**THEN** sign-on proceeds in the not-communicating state per design
**AND** the not-communicating condition is made clear to the Driver
